fields.label: Display Label
fields.description: Shown to shoppers instead of the warehouse name (e.g. "Store", "Supplier stock"). Translatable through the Translation doctype.

fields.label: Auto-enable when in stock
fields.description: Every published Website Item with stock in this source displays it automatically (no per-item setup). Uncheck to only show it on items that list this source explicitly.

fields.label: Stock Basis
fields.description: Warehouse Bin reads real ERPNext stock. Item Field reads a numeric custom field on Item (e.g. a synced supplier stock) without creating any valued stock.

fields.label: Item Stock Field
fields.description: Fieldname on Item holding the quantity, e.g. neo_supplier_stock.

fields.label: Supplier Source
fields.description: Ordered quantities from this source feed the supplier procurement flow (draft Purchase Order or Material Request).

fields.label: Supplier
fields.description: Purchase Orders are grouped under this supplier. Falls back to the item's default supplier when empty.

fields.label: Receiving Warehouse
fields.description: Where the goods physically arrive (target warehouse of the Purchase Order). Defaults to the item's website warehouse.

fields.label: Lead Time Mode
fields.description: Fixed: constant number of business days. Periodic: supplier orders leave on a schedule (e.g. end of month), the estimate accounts for the next departure.

fields.label: Supplier Order Leaves
fields.options:
End of Month
Weekly
Day of Month

fields.label: Order Weekday
fields.options:
Monday
Tuesday
Wednesday
Thursday
Friday
Saturday
Sunday

fields.label: Receipt Lead (business days)
fields.description: Business days between the supplier order departure and the goods arriving.

fields.label: Handling (business days)
fields.description: Business days to prepare and ship after the goods arrived.
